capabilities.name: Collaboration Data and Sync Model
capabilities.description: Represent shared projects, workspaces, revisions, memberships, roles, permissions, presence, comments, activity, locks, and synchronization records.
capabilities.source: v1.20 — Wave 1.20.1 Collaboration data model sync architecture GitHub and activity

capabilities.name: GitHub and Project Activity Integration
capabilities.description: Integrate approved repository, branch, commit, issue, link, and project activity workflows without making Git mandatory.
capabilities.source: v1.20 — Wave 1.20.1 Collaboration data model sync architecture GitHub and activity

capabilities.name: Local Network and Cloud Collaboration Routing
capabilities.description: Support local-network discovery and collaboration plus optional cloud routing through provider contracts.
capabilities.source: v1.20 — Wave 1.20.1 Collaboration data model sync architecture GitHub and activity
capabilities.notes: Offline-first ownership and project exportability remain mandatory.

capabilities.name: Small Team Shared Workspaces
capabilities.description: Support teams of 2–5 with invitations, roles, permissions, presence, shared recents, activity, comments, review, tasks, status, and notifications.
capabilities.source: v1.20 — Wave 1.20.2 Teams shared projects workspaces roles permissions and invitations
capabilities.notes: Large-enterprise administration remains outside Official Version 1.

capabilities.name: Collaborative Conflict Resolution
capabilities.description: Provide revision comparison, conflict detection, manual resolution, safe approved auto-merge, locks, stale-copy warnings, and per-resource ownership behavior.
capabilities.source: v1.20 — Wave 1.20.3 Conflict resolution offline edits shared assets and recovery

capabilities.name: Offline Collaboration Recovery
capabilities.description: Recover from offline edits, reconnects, interrupted synchronization, clock differences, missing assets, schema mismatches, and partial uploads.
capabilities.source: v1.20 — Wave 1.20.3 Conflict resolution offline edits shared assets and recovery
capabilities.notes: Cross-slice project snapshots must restore consistent state after failed collaborative changes.

capabilities.name: Extension and Workflow Stacking
capabilities.description: Run multiple extension and workflow packs together with declared dependencies, optional dependencies, versions, capabilities, precedence, and load order.
capabilities.source: v1.20 — Wave 1.20.4 Extension stacking dependency resolution capability sharing and recovery

capabilities.name: Extension Stack Conflict and Recovery Mode
capabilities.description: Detect dependency, permission, command, UI, API-version, capability, and resource conflicts before activation and provide stack recovery mode.
capabilities.source: v1.20 — Wave 1.20.4 Extension stacking dependency resolution capability sharing and recovery
capabilities.notes: An incompatible extension stack may not create permanent startup lockout.

capabilities.name: Community Developer Marketplace Beta
capabilities.description: Support community submissions, publishers, package validation, scanning, permission review, verification, staging, moderation, reports, reviews, metrics, and publisher operations.
capabilities.source: v1.20 — Wave 1.20.5 Community developer beta verification moderation and publisher operations
capabilities.notes: Official, verified, community, and experimental status must remain unambiguous.

capabilities.name: Official Version 1 Release Candidate Convergence
capabilities.description: Converge performance, memory, recovery, accessibility, UX, documentation, security, privacy, packaging, updater, rollback, and all-system validation into the Official Version 1 release candidate.
capabilities.source: v1.20 — Waves 1.20.6 through 1.20.8 and final release gate
capabilities.notes: No release-blocking data-loss, security, installer, accessibility, or core-workflow defect may remain.
